presets.name: Classic
presets.note: The dependable starting point. Scan your saved image before sharing or printing.

presets.name: Reverse
presets.note: Light-on-dark codes need a reader that supports inversion. Test with the phones you expect people to use; choose Classic for widest compatibility.

presets.name: Clear
presets.note: Place on a plain, light background and keep the clear border. The background becomes part of the code. Scan the final design before using it.

presets.name: Frost
presets.note: A translucent white panel softens the background. Keep it plain, keep the border, and scan the final design before using it.
